runs.firstUnproved: the tool's own checker met 1 gap, a construct it does not implement as the JVM does, and refused it (--gaps strict): jdk-reference-method:java.lang.StringBuilder.append(Ljava/lang/CharSequence;II)Ljava/lang/StringBuilder;@jdk-21.0.13 (java.lang.StringBuilder.append(java.lang.CharSequence, int, int) at com.google.common.base.Strings.lenientFormat:283). With --gaps assume it assumes instead that java.lang.StringBuilder.append(java.lang.CharSequence, int, int) returns a new object, never null: it throws nothing and changes neither its receiver nor its arguments, and the verdict names the assumption

JBMC's counterexample retained(typed=true) is no reproduction in the interpreter, which cannot run the method on it (unsupported: StringBuilder.append(Ljava/lang/CharSequence;II)Ljava/lang/StringBuilder;); on a JVM (JDK 21.0.13), the method returns true there and the property holds on it, so it is no counterexample.
